summary: Round 6 — tested new REINVEST + COMPARE VAULTS features (both backend & frontend) plus regression. All 25 backend tests pass (6 new for /api/reinvest). End-to-end frontend flow verified for reinvest dialog and vault comparison panel with math checks. No blocking issues.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent}. Not blocking; adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby='undefined' would silence and improve a11y.

compare_verifications.compare-amount input recalculates 'Yield: PASS — xrp_flex @1000 -> +52/+52; @5000 -> +260/+260; vip_diamond @5000 -> +1,923.29 (90d) / +7,800.00 (annual). Math matches amount * apy * (dur/365) for term and amount*apy for annualized.

regression_verifications.New stake created via reinvest starts ac: Observed — reinvest-button reappeared shortly after reinvest because the new xrp_flex stake accrued micro-profit; consistent with spec's 'minus tiny time drift'.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to reinvest-dialog and stake-dialog to silence Radix console warning.

(Optional UX) After reinvest, the Reinvest button re-appears immediately because the new stake starts accruing >0 within ms — consider hiding the button while profit < some small epsilon (e.g. < 1 XRP) or < selected vault min. Not a bug per spec but slightly noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py serialize_stake now correctly subtracts claimed_profit from accrued, preventing double-count after reinvest — verified end-to-end.
reinvest endpoint snapshots accrued once per stake and writes claimed_profit=that accrued value; safe against re-entry but not transactional across users (acceptable for single-user compound).
ReinvestDialog fetches /vaults on open — could reuse serverState-cached list from a shared context, but not blocking.
No _id leak in any response; all endpoints use str(_id).
test_credentials: Admin: username=admin phrase='legal winner thank year wave sausage worth useful legal winner thank yellow'. Test users are auto-created per test via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test seeded a UI test user via API and injected xp_token into localStorage to bypass PIN vault (only present after explicit CreateWallet flow). No leftover admin state changes beyond +500 bonus_profit on transient user accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reinvest + Compare features are green E2E. Auth in this app is username + 12-word phrase + local PIN vault; the fastest way to test authenticated pages in Playwright is: register user via POST /api/auth/register, then localStorage.setItem('xp_token', token) and navigate to /app — this skips the PIN unlock (only enforced when a vault entry exists). Give a user profit fast via admin POST /api/admin/users/{id}/adjust-profit (bonus_profit).
